params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever {{ci|Nilah}} kills a {{tip|minion}}, she and the nearest allied champion gain an additional portion of the {{as|{{sti|experience}}}} they would have lost from sharing.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nilah''' shares a bonus portion of {{tip|heal|healing}} or {{tip|shield|shielding}} with nearby allied champions that apply healing or shielding to her or themselves.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Nilah''' [[kill]]s a {{tip|minion}}, she and the nearest allied {{tip|champion}} gain an additional {{sti|{{as|50% of the experience}}}} they would have lost from sharing.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby allied champion uses an {{tip|ability}} to {{tip|heal}} or {{tip|shield}} either '''Nilah''' or themselves, both they and '''Nilah''' receive a '''bonus''' amount equal to {{fd|7.5}}% of the healing or 15% of the shielding after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. '''Bonus''' shielding lasts as long as the shield that triggered the effect, up to a maximum duration of 4 seconds.
params.notes:
* '''Nilah''' will gain a portion of all healing and all shielding from nearby allies that activate either of the effects on themselves while she is within range of them.
** The same applies to allies that grant '''Nilah''' a heal or shield; they gain a portion of the heal or shield given to her by them, even if the heal or shield affects both units.
* Heal and shields granted by [[item]]s, [[rune]]s, and [[summoner spell]]s will '''not''' trigger the increased amount.
* The heal and shield increases do not trigger from their own heal or shield.
* '''Nilah''' may still gain a shield from her allies' shields even if they are longer than 4 seconds, but the buff of the shield will only last for up to 4 seconds.
* '''Nilah''' can receive a normal shield from nearby allies that gain [[Shield#Physical shields|physical]] or [[Shield#Magic shields|magic]] shields.

description.plain: Passive: Nilah gains 0% – 30% (based on critical strike chance) armor penetration. Her basic attacks and Formless Blade heal her for 0% – 20% (based on critical strike chance) of the post-mitigation damage dealt to champions, converting each heal instance beyond maximum health into a shield that lasts 6 seconds.

description2.plain: Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade in a line in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit, increased by ⟦critical damage⟧. Formless Blade can hit structures and applies life steal at 100% effectiveness to one target.

description3.plain: If Formless Blade is cast during Slipstream, Nilah leaves behind a wave that is sent towards her location at the end of the dash, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.

description4.plain: If Formless Blade hits an enemy, Nilah empowers herself for 4 seconds: gaining 125 bonus attack range and 10% – 60% (based on level) bonus attack speed, and causing her basic attacks to strike in a cone that deals 100% AD physical damage to enemies hit. Against secondary non-champion targets, this is reduced to 33% AD for minions, and additionally executes minions left below 20 health. On-hit effects are applied only to the primary target.

blurb.plain: Passive: Nilah gains armor penetration based on her critical strike chance. Also, her basic attacks and Formless Blade against champions heal her based on her critical strike chance; overhealing becomes a shield that lasts a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade in a line, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, increased based on her critical chance. Casting Formless Blade during Slipstream leaves a wave behind instead that deals the same damage to enemies it passes through.

blurb3.plain: If Formless Blade hits an enemy, Nilah becomes empowered for a short time: gaining attack range, attack speed, and causing her attacks to strike in a cone.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nilah}} briefly envelops herself in mist, during which she gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{as|{{sti|ms|move speed}}}} and {{as|magic damage}} reduction, and {{tip|dodge|dodges}} all non-turret basic attacks.
params.blurb2: Allied champions she touches will also be enveloped.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' envelops herself in mist for {{fd|2.25}} seconds, during which she becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, reduces all incoming {{as|magic damage}} taken by 25%, and {{tip|dodge|dodges}} all non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks.
params.description2: Allied champions {{tt|she touches|Being within collision range of them}} will also be enveloped for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, gaining the same effects.
params.notes:
* Allies may only be affected by ''Jubilant Veil'' once every 6 seconds.
* ''Jubilant Veil's'' cooldown is not affected by {{ii|Spear of Shojin}} {{sbc|Dragonforce}}.{{bug}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nilah}} whirls her whip-blade for a brief moment, continually dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. She then bursts to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|pull in}} nearby enemies. Each hit will also {{tip|slow}} enemies for a short time.
params.blurb2: '''Nilah''' {{tip|heals}} herself and nearby allied champions for a portion of the damage dealt to {{tip|champions}}, based on her {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}, and converting overhealing into {{tip|shield|shielding}} that lasts for a moderate amount of time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' whirls her whip-blade over 1 second, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. She then unleashes a burst that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them 250 units towards her. Each hit also {{tip|slows}} targets by 10% for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
params.description2: '''Nilah''' {{tip|heals}} herself and nearby allied champions for {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|20 to 50 for 11|0 to 100|formula=20% + 0.3% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to {{tip|champions}}, reduced to 10% against non-champions, converting each heal instance beyond {{as|'''maximum''' health}} into a {{tip|shield}} that last 6 seconds.
params.description3: '''''Nilah''' is unable to basic attack and cast her other [[champion ability|abilities]] during Apotheosis, but she is able to move.''
